description: GCompris is open showing a category of activities. Find and open the solo 'Memory game with images' (the single-player version, not the one labeled 'against Tux'). In this activity, a grid of face-down cards appears. Click a card to flip it, then click another to try to find its match. Matching pairs stay face up; non-matching cards flip back down. Find and match all pairs of cards to complete the game.
